description: Owll is an AI note-taking product for meetings, recordings, documents, images, and other content. Owll for ChatGPT connects to a user’s authorized Owll library, allowing them to search notes, browse folders, view note details and AI-generated summaries, and access or export transcripts upon request. The current version provides read-only access and cannot create, edit, or delete notes.

defaultPrompt: Find my notes about the pricing discussion and summarize the key decisions.
What did I record last week? Give me the highlights.
Export the transcript of my latest meeting as a text file.
